fact: The Education Sector Development Plan 2025/26-2029/30 states that the School Information System (SIS), managed by PO-RALG, has been reengineered to cover all regions in government and non-government primary and secondary schools, feeds real-time data that schools and Ward Education Officers capture online or offline, and is to be further enhanced and mainstreamed into ESMIS; it gives no number of schools using it.
title: Education Sector Development Plan 2025/26 - 2029/30
publisher: The United Republic of Tanzania, Ministry of Education, Science and Technology
